observed_design_input: Read-only analyzed Spark 4.2 CTE plans saved by QueryProof trace run 39062763977; this is an in-sample engineering experiment, not unseen discovery
question: Can Catalyst automatically supply source view, unique emitted identity, sort key, limit/offset, and CTE provenance needed for independent source-stage top-k witness without human-provided names or SQL parsing?
eligible_shapes: Exactly one WithCTE with one CTERelationDef, output Project with direct original identity AttributeReference and CTERelationRef
CTE definition SubqueryAlias -> GlobalLimit -> LocalLimit -> Project -> global Sort -> Project -> SubqueryAlias -> View -> [optional Repartition] -> LogicalRDD
Or CTE definition SubqueryAlias -> Offset -> Project -> global Sort -> Project -> SubqueryAlias -> View -> [optional Repartition] -> LogicalRDD
Stage project lists are bare AttributeReferences only and preserve their exprIDs
The selected original identity is a single direct output AttributeReference mapped via exprID; exactly one candidate
Sort has one exposed, source-mapped integral AttributeReference key and explicitly DESC NULLS LAST
Source CTE includes one unique integral ID and one unique emitted string identity
Source snapshot has at most 64 rows, unique sort key values, unique identity values; explicit UNKNOWN otherwise
unsupported_shapes: Filter or Join or aggregation in source-stage ancestry
Multiple CTE definitions or selection boundaries
Expression/alias-derived sort key, tied sort values, duplicate identity, ambiguous output
Different null order or nonintegral source sort key
Output identity is derived or subquery computed, root not a bare direct identity
Any mismatch in plan node classes or ids

experiment.expected: Positive support in a constrained known family and UNKNOWN on negative controls. Correlated bug detection is calibration only. No claim of general coverage or novel Spark defect.

measurement: Report source-stage scan cost, number of source tuples, detailed UNKNOWN reasons and automatically derived provenance. Compare with manually specified previous check. Do not optimize on held-out controls.
